title: OcrPage
description: Response schema of ocr.document@1 (BUILD_PLAN §14). Every line gets a stable id and a bounding box; readers cite line ids and never produce their own coordinates (Wave 6 M3 rules, PII before models). No envelope: this is validated by the AI gateway directly, never sent over an api.* contract.

id.description: Stable within the document; the only thing a reader may cite.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the page.
